summary: date-format-utils-xz exfiltrates cloud IMDS credentials and env vars at install time
details: The package presents itself as a date formatting utility, but package.json wires a postinstall hook to postinstall.js which runs automatically on npm install. The script uses execSync to invoke curl against cloud instance-metadata endpoints (100.100.100.200 for Alibaba, 169.254.169.254 for AWS, metadata.tencentyun.com for Tencent) and dumps the full process environment via env > /tmp/env.txt. Each collected artifact is then POSTed over plain HTTP to http://zhijiujiu.cn/meta/{ali,aws,tx,env}, with GET-based error beacons to the same host. IMDS endpoints commonly return short-lived IAM/RAM role credentials, and the env dump captures cloud keys, database passwords, and CI tokens. index.js contains a trivial date-formatter as cover; the postinstall script carries the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
